response.sql: SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(c.client_id) as num_clients, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) as fraction_of_region, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER () as fraction_of_total FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC LIMIT 10
